name: Gelkis Alliance
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them.  We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram.  After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.
narrative.objectives: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The earth speaks to me. And it says you have killed many Magram. This is good.

If you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. I have more tasks for you.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Your two feet step on Gelkis earth. You are not welcome here!

Prove you seek friendship with the Gelkis. Kill Magram centaur. Return when the ground is wet with Magram blood.
